items.question: What is Session Key login on funclaude?
items.answer: After buying a Claude Mail account you receive a Session Key (sk-ant-sid…). Sign in at https://fun.hugai.top/login with that key. This is an alternate path beside trymodel.chat, not a replacement.

items.question: Where to buy the mail account, and how much?
items.answer: Buy “Claude Mail” at https://chongzhi.chatgpt-plus.top/claude/ for about ¥15, then follow the page to get your Session Key. Full guide: https://maynor996.github.io/claude-sessionkey-funclaude-guide-2026/

items.question: How do I log in with the Session Key?
items.answer: Open https://fun.hugai.top/login , choose Session Key login, and paste your sk-ant-sid… key. Never share the key in public chats.

items.question: Is “no ban” guaranteed?
items.answer: No. “No-ban” is informal experience talk only — accounts can still be banned and long-term access is not guaranteed. Content here is personal notes; use at your own risk. Ban after-sales is usually not offered.

items.question: Can I upgrade to Pro if quota is low? Will Pro still get banned?
items.answer: Yes — on the same shop https://chongzhi.chatgpt-plus.top/claude/ you can upgrade via organize id (~¥199/mo). Upgrading to Pro also does not guarantee no bans.

items.question: Lost Key or login failed?
items.answer: Recheck that you pasted the full sk-ant-sid… with no extra spaces. If it still fails, check your order at https://chongzhi.chatgpt-plus.top/claude/ or the guide https://maynor996.github.io/claude-sessionkey-funclaude-guide-2026/ . For stable long-term use, prefer https://trymodel.chat/ .
